Entity.name: Balance sheet recognised exchange tradable derivative liability position
Entity.commentInRDBMS: An Exchange tradable derivative liability position is an Exchange tradable derivative position role which is balance sheet recognised.

Attribute.name: Balance sheet recognised exchange tradable derivative liability position type
Attribute.comment: A discriminator to distinguish between different types of Balance sheet recognised exchange tradable derivative liability positions.

Attribute.name: Carrying amount
Attribute.comment: The carrying amount in accordance with Annex V to Implementing Regulation (EU) No 680/2014.

Attribute.name: Accounting classification
Attribute.comment: Accounting portfolio where the asset or liability is recorded in accordance with the accounting standard – IFRS or national GAAP –under Regulation (EU) 2015/534 (ECB/2015/13) applied by the observed agent's legal entity.

Attribute.name: Balance sheet recognised exchange tradable derivative liability position accounting standard type
Attribute.comment: Balance sheet recognised exchange tradable derivative liability position accounting standard type distinguishes the Balance sheet recognised exchange tradable derivative liability position by the applied accounting standard.
